jobs.title: Payments Program Manager
jobs.description:
Zenoti provides an all-in-one, cloud-based software solution for the beauty and wellness industry. Our solution allows users to seamlessly manage every aspect of the business in a comprehensive mobile solution: online appointment bookings, POS, CRM, employee management, inventory management, built-in marketing programs and more. Zenoti helps clients streamline their systems and reduce costs, while simultaneously improving customer retention and spending. Our platform is engineered for reliability and scale and harnesses the power of enterprise-level technology for businesses of all sizes

Zenoti powers more than 30,000 salons, spas, medspas and fitness studios in over 50 countries. This includes a vast portfolio of global brands, such as European Wax Center, Hand & Stone, Massage Heights, Rush Hair & Beauty, Sono Bello, Profile by Sanford, Hair Cuttery, CorePower Yoga and TONI&GUY.

Our recent accomplishments include surpassing a $1 billion unicorn valuation, being named Next Tech Titan by GeekWire, raising an $80 million investment from TPG, ranking as the 316th fastest-growing company in North America on Deloitte’s 2020 Technology Fast 500™. We are also proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work CertifiedTM for 2021-2022 as this reaffirms our commitment to empowering people to feel good and find their greatness. To learn more about Zenoti visit: https://www.zenoti.com

We are looking for an outstanding candidate for a Program Manager - Payments role within the Payments Operations team at Zenoti. The Payments Operations Team is focused on ensuring efficient, secure, and compliant payment processing, enabling new payment options and improving the existing payments experience for our customers. This team plays a crucial role in driving Zenoti's ability to connect with Payment Service Providers and Banks and offer a diverse range of Pay-in and Pay-out methods, including cards, bank transfers, and alternative payment methods such as wallets, etc. This data-driven program manager will develop a solid understanding of new payment capabilities and excitement for innovation and process improvement, along with stellar communication skills.

As a Program Manager, Payments, you will interact with senior leadership and business partners directly and drive efforts to build payment programs, improve operations and incident management procedures, and use metrics to track payments and partner performance. You will partner with product, engineers, operations, data analytics, and other program managers to create programs and procedures from scratch that deliver exponential value to our SaaS customers globally.

What will I be doing?

- Help define the payment product strategy, roadmap, and build a prioritization framework that captures relevant tradeoffs for the team while creating organizational alignment

- Understand the payment ecosystem and Zenoti's SaaS platform end-to-end, the APIs in our systems, and the dependencies, and use this knowledge to improve our payment systems

- Manage and oversee various cross-functional programs, ensuring successful delivery.

- Set clear objectives for programs, leveraging data analytics to drive improvements and achieve metrics.

- Navigate and resolve ambiguities in business scenarios, applying creative problem-solving skills.

- Foster collaboration with internal and external partners to optimize resource allocation and project success.

- Evaluate and prioritize projects in conjunction with customer needs and technical team inputs.

- Identify and mitigate risks, preventing them from escalating into major issues.

- Regularly communicate with senior managers, business leaders, and other stakeholders to support key business initiatives.

- Develop, implement, and oversee KPI reporting for a program portfolio, ensuring clear visibility of milestones and project performance.

- Stay abreast of regulations, compliance, and client contractual requirements, ensuring the company's adherence to legal and regulatory frameworks for different markets and clients

- Drive initiatives focused on innovation, efficiency, controls, standard processes & cost saving opportunities

What skills do I need?

- 8 - 15 years of relevant experience in program management and/or payments business operations, preferably within a SaaS environment.

- 5+ years of payments experience in the merchant and/or payments provider side (e.g., PSP, acquirer, aggregator, etc.), ideally integrated within SaaS platforms.

- Experience driving medium-to-large-sized technical projects with external financial partners and cross-functional internal stakeholders in a SaaS or technology company.

- Success driving results, identifying and solving issues, and sound decision-making.

- Proficiency in analyzing business needs and creating necessary documentation and system improvement requests to optimize functionality and productivity of SaaS-based payment solutions.

- Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.

- Experience working with the product team and engineers to make tough technical tradeoffs, and you can sweat the details to understand the impacts of these tradeoffs and find a careful balance between short-term outcomes and long-term effects.

Benefits

- Best in industry salary

- Comprehensive medical coverage for yourself and your immediate family

- An environment where wellbeing is high on priority – access to regular yoga, meditation, breathwork, nutrition counseling, stress management, and inclusion of family for most benefit awareness building sessions

- Opportunities to be a part of a community and give back: Social activities are part of our culture; You can look forward to regular engagement, social work, and community give-back initiatives

jobs.title: Business Development Manager – Fitness Industry
jobs.description:
Zenoti provides an all-in-one, cloud-based software solution for the beauty and wellness industry. Our solution allows users to seamlessly manage every aspect of the business in a comprehensive mobile solution: online appointment bookings, POS, CRM, employee management, inventory management, built-in marketing programs and more. Zenoti helps clients streamline their systems and reduce costs, while simultaneously improving customer retention and spending. Our platform is engineered for reliability and scale and harnesses the power of enterprise-level technology for businesses of all sizes

Zenoti powers more than 30,000 salons, spas, medspas and fitness studios in over 50 countries. This includes a vast portfolio of global brands, such as European Wax Center, Hand & Stone, Massage Heights, Rush Hair & Beauty, Sono Bello, Profile by Sanford, Hair Cuttery, CorePower Yoga and TONI&GUY.

Our recent accomplishments include surpassing a $1 billion unicorn valuation, being named Next Tech Titan by GeekWire, raising an $80 million investment from TPG, ranking as the 316th fastest-growing company in North America on Deloitte’s 2020 Technology Fast 500™. We are also proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work CertifiedTM for 2021-2022 as this reaffirms our commitment to empowering people to feel good and find their greatness. To learn more about Zenoti visit: https://www.zenoti.com

About the Role

Zenoti is expanding aggressively into the fitness market, and we’re looking for a connector — someone who lives and breathes the fitness industry and knows how to turn relationships into revenue. This is not a closing role. You are the tip of the spear: building Zenoti’s presence in the fitness community through events, networking, partnerships, and warm introductions that feed a high-performing sales team.

If you have a Rolodex full of gym owners, boutique studio operators, fitness franchise contacts, and industry insiders — and you know how to work a room — this role was built for you.

What You’ll Do

Industry Networking & Relationship Building

Leverage your existing network and continuously build new relationships with independent gym operators, multi-location fitness brands, franchise groups, and key ecosystem players (equipment vendors, consultants, fitness associations). Be the face of Zenoti in the fitness community.

Local & Regional Event Activation

Identify, plan, and execute local events — roundtables, lunch-and-learns, gym owner meetups, and co-branded partner events — that bring qualified prospects into Zenoti’s orbit. Own the event calendar from ideation to follow-up.

Industry Conference & Trade Show Presence

Represent Zenoti at key fitness industry events (IHRSA, Club Industry, Boutique Fitness Summit, etc.). Work the floor, set meetings, and ensure Zenoti is a recognizable and respected name in every room you enter.

Pipeline Generation

Convert relationships and event attendees into qualified opportunities. Hand off warm, well-documented leads to the Account Executive team with full context and deal-readiness notes. You’re measured on pipeline created, not deals closed.

Partner & Channel Development

Identify and cultivate strategic partnerships with fitness equipment brands, POS providers, gym design firms, and fitness consultants who can refer Zenoti to their clients.

Market Intelligence

Stay close to what’s happening in the fitness industry — who’s growing, who’s struggling, what operators care about — and feed those insights back to marketing and product.

What Success Looks Like

- Consistent pipeline contribution: a monthly quota of qualified opportunities passed to AEs

- Active local event calendar with measurable attendance and lead output

- Growing network of fitness industry contacts that translates into warm introductions

- Strong relationships with 2–3 strategic referral partners within the first 6 months

What We’re Looking For

- 5+ years of experience in the fitness industry

- Proven existing network of gym owners, studio operators, or fitness brand decision-makers

- Track record of using relationships and events to generate business opportunities

- Natural networker and connector — you’re energized by meeting new people and building community

- Strong communication and storytelling skills; able to convey Zenoti’s value clearly and compellingly

- Organized and self-directed — able to manage a regional territory and events calendar independently

- Comfortable with CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot) and tracking pipeline activity

- Willingness to travel regionally for events, conferences, and prospect meetings

Compensation & Benefits

- Variable/bonus tied to qualified pipeline generated

- Full benefits package

- Conference and event budget

Why Zenoti

Zenoti powers over 30,000 businesses across salons, spas, and wellness — and we’re bringing that same enterprise-grade platform to the fitness world. You’ll be joining at the ground floor of a major market push, with the tools, brand, and product to back you up.
Zenoti Pay Range
$80,000 — $95,000 USD

Director of Sales – Mid-Market

Location: North America
Reports to: VP - GTM
Department: GTM/Sales

Work Type: Hybrid, Seattle/Bellevue

About Zenoti

Zenoti powers the world’s leading beauty, wellness, and fitness brands — helping them grow, delight their guests, and run their businesses effortlessly. Our platform combines SaaS, payments, and AI-driven innovation to help operators scale profitably and deliver exceptional guest experiences.

We are seeking a proven Director of Sales, Mid-Market, to lead new customer acquisition across our fastest-growing segment.

Role Overview

The Director of Sales, Mid-Market owns net new revenue generation for businesses ranging from single-location and multi-location brands with up to 20 locations. This leader will manage and develop a team of 6–8 Account Executives responsible for expanding Zenoti’s footprint.

This leader will balance people leadership, pipeline rigor, and deal execution , ensuring the team consistently sells on value, ROI, and business impact.

Key Responsibilities

- Own mid-market new ARR

- Drive predictable pipeline generation, progression, and close rates.

- Maintain strong forecast accuracy and proactive risk management.

- Lead and Develop a High-Performance Sales Team

- Recruit, onboard, coach, and retain top mid-market SaaS sales talent.

- Build a culture of accountability, coaching, and continuous improvement.

- Execute Challenger sales methodology and value-led selling

- Coach reps to sell on ROI, outcomes, and long-term value, not features or price.

- Inspect deals for quality, customer fit, and executive alignment.

- Drive Sales Operating Excellence

- Partner with Revenue Operations to ensure clean CRM hygiene, accurate reporting, and strong pipeline visibility.

- Lead weekly pipeline reviews, forecast calls, and quarterly performance reviews.

- Use data to identify coaching needs, execution gaps, and scalable best practices.

Qualifications

- 7+ years of SaaS sales leadership experience, with a proven track record of building and leading teams that deliver sustained net new ARR growth.

- Data-driven leader with a strong command of pipeline math, forecasting, and performance metrics.

- Track record of hiring, coaching, and developing high-performing sales teams.

- Executive presence and strong communication skills with both customers and internal leaders.

Success in This Role Looks Like

- Consistent achievement (and outperformance) of mid-market ARR targets.

- A confident, well-coached sales team that accelerates deal velocity and win rates.

- Predictable pipeline generation and disciplined forecasting.

- Zenoti recognized by prospects as the leading strategic growth platform , not just a software vendor.
